answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 36548 Country: India Title: My own sister's son was breastfed by my own mother at his birth up to four days Question: My own sister's son was breastfed by my own mother at his birth up to four days. Can I marry my daughter to my own sister's son who was breastfed by my own mother? Answer ID: 36548 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 218/124/H=1433) No, you cannot do so because this nikah is haram. Your mother (who is nani of the boy) became his foster mother and you (mamu of the boy) became foster brother of the boy and your daughter became foster bhatiji (niece) of the boy. It is haram to marry one's foster bhatiji as it is haram to marry one's nasabi (genealogical) bhatiji. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
